update: UPDATE account_state SET truth_ip = CASE account_id WHEN #{row.accountId} THEN #{row.truthIp} END, proxy_country = CASE account_id WHEN #{row.accountId} THEN #{row.proxyCountry} END, proxy_source = CASE account_id WHEN #{row.accountId} THEN #{row.proxySource} END, updated_at = CASE account_id WHEN #{row.accountId} THEN #{row.updatedAt} END WHERE account_id IN #{row.accountId}
